name: Montavilla

characteristics.housing_stock: 1920s-1950s bungalows, Craftsman cottages, and ranches — mixed condition, some excellent blocks and some rough edges
characteristics.transit_access: Good — MAX Blue Line at 82nd Ave station, frequent bus on Stark/Washington, Division
characteristics.crime_trend: Improving — down 6% YoY, commercial district revitalization helping
characteristics.development_pipeline: Montavilla commercial district continued growth, 82nd Ave city ownership transition bringing investment, Academy Theater anchors cultural scene

investment_thesis: Mixed neighborhood with excellent block-by-block upside. The Montavilla commercial district around SE Stark and 76th-80th has genuine charm (Academy Theater, restaurants, shops) and drives buyer interest. Properties within a few blocks of the commercial core command significant premiums over those near 82nd. Smart strategy is to buy unrenovated homes on good blocks near the core and renovate to match neighborhood comps. MAX Blue Line access at 82nd adds transit value. The 82nd Ave transfer to city jurisdiction is bringing infrastructure investment.
risk_factors: Very block-dependent — some areas near 82nd still challenging
82nd Ave transition is positive long-term but construction disruption near-term
Some noise from Stark/Washington couplet traffic
Competition from savvy local investors who know the micro-markets
